title: phyllanthus stipulaceus
intro: Phyllanthus stipulaceus, commonly known as wax leaf Phyllanthus or Carolina wax leaf, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Phyllanthus stipulaceus include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory problems due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus stipulaceus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities.
